capability.name: generate-thumbnail
capability.description: Generate a thumbnail image preview of the document

required.name: file_path
required.description: Path to the document file to process

optional.name: width
optional.description: Width of the thumbnail in pixels

optional.name: height
optional.description: Height of the thumbnail in pixels

optional.name: output
optional.description: Write thumbnail to specified file instead of stdout

optional.name: page
optional.description: Page number to generate thumbnail from (1-based, default: 1)

response.description: PNG image data representing a thumbnail of the document

FILE_NOT_FOUND.description: The specified file does not exist

UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT.description: The file format is not supported by this plugin

INVALID_PAGE.description: The specified page number does not exist in the document

NO_VISUAL_CONTENT.message: Document contains no visual content for thumbnail generation
NO_VISUAL_CONTENT.description: The document does not contain renderable visual content

THUMBNAIL_GENERATION_FAILED.description: Thumbnail generation process failed due to internal error
